shellCommands.command:
/bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'next.config.*' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'middleware.*' -g 'proxy.*' | sed -n '1,240p'
git status --short
node -p \"const p=require('./package.json'); JSON.stringify({scripts:p.scripts,dependencies:p.dependencies,devDependencies:p.devDependencies},null,2)\""

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' AGENTS.md
sed -n '1,220p' app/page.tsx
sed -n '1,220p' app/layout.tsx
sed -n '1,220p' next.config.ts
rg -n --glob '*.md' \"proxy\\.ts|middleware\\.ts|Proxy|Middleware\" node_modules/next/dist/docs | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sort | sed -n '1,240p'
sed -n '1,220p' tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null || true
git diff -- package.json
git diff --stat"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short
git diff -- proxy.ts tsconfig.json package.json
sed -n '1,220p' tsconfig.json
sed -n '1,120p' .gitignore 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short
git diff --check
git diff -- tsconfig.json
sed -n '1,120p' proxy.ts"
